title: Claims Settlement Worksheet: Systems Settlement Amount, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
**Computation.** On a Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage, the scheduled systems settlement is the program's cash-in-lieu maximum multiplied by the systems share of 0.40, the product rounded to the nearest cent. The systems settlement is the scheduled systems settlement, and the systems settlement never exceeds the program's cash-in-lieu maximum, that comparison being made on the systems settlement itself.

The cash-in-lieu maximum is the figure of the home's HomeCare program in its schedule of cash settlement limits.

| Line | Entry |
|---|---|
| A | The program's cash-in-lieu maximum |
| B | Systems share: 0.40 |
| C | Scheduled systems settlement: line A multiplied by line B, rounded to the nearest cent |
| D | Systems settlement: line C, never more than line A |

## Worked figures (hypothetical maxima)

| Program cash-in-lieu maximum | Scheduled systems settlement | Systems settlement |
|---|---|---|
| USD 750.00 | USD 300.00 | USD 300.00 |
| USD 1500.00 | USD 600.00 | USD 600.00 |
| USD 2500.00 | USD 1000.00 | USD 1000.00 |
